name: Icom Incorporated
summary: Icom Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells telecommunication equipment in Japan, the United States, Canada, Germany, Spain, Australia, China, and Vietnam. The company manufactures and sells information and communication equipment, including land-based professional radio communication equipment, amateur radio communication equipment, maritime radio communication equipment, other wireless communication equipment, and network equipment.
